blocks.html:
Fixtures capable of supplying an emergency source of potable water in accordance with this section shall consist of a faucet conforming to Section 424 or a fixture conforming to Section 424 that is capable of attaching to a splitter and either:
   1.   a sink conforming to Section 418; or
   2.   a floor drain conforming to Section 412.
